title: Translation review
idea: Translation review: Source and translation stay aligned around selected segments with glossary, direction and review status nearby.
audience: People who need to review translation within a product-web surface.
avoidWhen: Machine output is represented as approved human review.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic document layout through its review translation priority and explicit commitment contract: Preserve source version and separate generated, edited and approved translation states.
navigation: Translation review keeps the current review translation context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Source and translation stay aligned around selected segments with glossary, direction and review status nearby.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to review translation; reviewers need precise source-to-target correspondence.
composition.priority: Preserve source version and separate generated, edited and approved translation states.

imagery.role: Support the actual review translation context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use segment-by-segment focus with correct bidirectional text and readable script metrics.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the translation review structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no review translation content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Preserve source version and separate generated, edited and approved translation states.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized review translation content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Preserve source version and separate generated, edited and approved translation states.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active review translation context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
